1.

The applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Mirzachouki P.S. Case No.45 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 175/ 379/ 414/
420 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 4/ 54 of the J.M.MC Rule and Sections 7/ 9 of the Jharkhand Minerals (Prevention of Illegal Mining Transporting and Storage) Rule 2017, pending in the court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Sahibganj.

entities.text: Jharkhand Minerals (Prevention of Illegal Mining Transporting and Storage) Rule 2017
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. After some argument, learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission to withdraw the present anticipatory bail application.
3. Learned counsel for the State has no objection.
4. In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the applicant, the present anticipatory bail application stands dismissed withdrawn.

5. However, the investigating agency and the trial court are directed to act as per the mandate of the Hon'ble Apex Court, in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vrs. Central Bureau of Investigation,
